translations.english: That great Vanara appeared as if he was gulping the entire ocean with its rising waves. While he was looking upward it appeared as though he was keen to drink in the sea as well.
translations.hindi: दोनों नेत्र ऐसे देख पड़ते थे जसे पर्वत पर दो ओर दावानल हों । उनकी पीली पीली झौर बड़ी बड़ी
